Method of Attack: Tech support scam pretending to be a security alert from Windows Defender
Redirecting users from fake YouTube Google ads to scam sites
Scam sites warn of Trojan Spyware infection
Prompting victims to install TeamViewer for remote access
Locking computers or demanding purchase of fake support license
Attack Vector: Malvertising campaign via Google Search ads for YouTube
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Google ads titled 'YouTube - Best of YouTube Videos' or 'YouTube.com - YouTube - Best of YouTube videos for You.'
